[[Mobile, Alabama]] }} '''DeMarcus Cousins''' (born August 13, 1990) is an American [[basketball]] player. Cousins is a 7'0", 290 lb power forward/center who played collegiately at the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|University of Kentucky]]. ==High school== Cousins was named to the 2009 [[McDonald's All-American Team]] where he scored 14 points and had 8 rebounds.{{cite web|url=http://seattletimes.nwsource.com/html/highschoolsports/2008969865_webhoopagatewed02.html?syndication=rss |title=Wednesday's McDonald's All-American Game box scores |publisher=Seattletimes.nwsource.com |date=April 2, 2009 |accessdate=March 22, 2010}} Cousins also played in the 2009 [[Nike Hoop Summit]] at the [[Rose Garden (arena)|Rose Garden]] in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]] and the Jordan Brand Classic at [[Madison Square Garden]] where he scored 10 points for the black team.{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/highschool/rise/basketball/boys/news/story?id=4080678 |title=Big men shine in Jordan Brand Classic |publisher=Sports.espn.go.com |date= |accessdate=March 22, 2010}}{{dead link|date=March 2010}} Cousins led LeFlore to the Alabama class 5A Final Four but fell short to future teammate [[Eric Bledsoe]] and [[Parker High School (Alabama)|Parker High School]]. ==College== Cousins first committed to [[UAB Blazers men's basketball|UAB]] on February 28, 2008 but never signed a [[National Letter of Intent|letter of intent]] because he wanted to be released if UAB's head coach, [[Mike Davis (coach)|Mike Davis]], left for another school, but the school refused to comply with this condition.{{cite web|url=http://blog.al.com/spotnews/2008/02/top_prospect_cousins_commits_t.html |title=Top basketball prospect DeMarcus Cousins commits to UAB |publisher=Blog.al.com |date=February 29, 2008 |accessdate=March 22, 2010}} Cousins decomitted from UAB and committed to [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]] on March 9, 2009.{{cite web|author=By Seth Davis, SI.com |url=http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/2009/basketball/ncaa/03/08/cousins.memphis/index.html |title=Prep standout Cousins commits to Memphis |publisher=Sportsillustrated.cnn.com |date=March 8, 2009 |accessdate=March 22, 2010}} He reopened his recruitment after then Memphis coach [[John Calipari]] was hired at Kentucky. On April 7, 2009, Cousins decided to follow John Calipari to Kentucky.{{cite web|last=Name |first=Author |url=http://slamonline.com/online/college-hs/college/2009/04/demarcus-cousins-to-kentucky/ |title=DeMarcus Cousins To Kentucky |publisher=Slamonline.com |date=April 9, 2009 |accessdate=March 22, 2010}} He signed his Letter of Intent on April 15. At Kentucky, Cousins averaged 15.1 points, 9.8 rebounds and 1.8 blocks per game. Led by Cousins and [[John Wall (basketball)|John Wall]], the Wildcats reached the [[Elite Eight]] of the [[2010 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2010 NCAA Tournament]]. ==NBA== On April 7, 2010, Cousins announced that he would forgo his final three seasons of collegiate eligibility and enter the [[2010 NBA Draft]], where he is expected to be a high lottery selection. {{citenews|url=http://www.2010draft.com/mockdraft/2010mockdraft.html |title=First-Round NBA Mock Draft 2010|date=June 6, 2010 |publisher=2010draft.com}} ==Awards/Honors== *2009–10 SEC Freshman of the Year *2009 [[2009 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American]] team selection *2009 Jordan Brand High School All-American team selection ==See also== * [[2010 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans]] ==References== {{reflist|2}} ==External links== *[http://www.ukathletics.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/cousins_demarcus00.html Kentucky Bio] *[http://www.nbadraft.net/players/demarcus-cousins NBADraft.net Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/DeMarcus-Cousins-1318/ DraftExpress.com Profile] *[http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=8&c=1&nid=2619228 Scout.com Profile] *[http://rivalshoops.rivals.com/viewprospect.asp?pr_key=50451&Sport=2 Rivals.com Profile] *[http://www.usabasketball.com/news.php?news_page=09_hsum_feature_cousins Nike Hoop Summit Bio] {{2010 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Cousins, DeMarcus}} [[Category:1990 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:People from Birmingham, Alabama]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Alabama]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] [[fr:DeMarcus Cousins]]
